thread:
incident-bot: Pager: High TPM on model family llm-llama4x in us-west1. Backend queues growing, latency spikes on production read paths. Paging eng-oncall.
alex: on it, dashboards show many inflight requests to llama4x primary fleet. KV cache miss rate up ~30% :grimacing:
priya: can we softcap RPM while we triage? want to avoid full outage for tenants.
matt: +1. proposing temporary RPM=1200, TPM unchanged for now. will apply via quota API and monitor.
sara: also suggest disabling funcall for llama4x for next 30m — lots of callers with heavy tool calls.
ryan: re-route 30% of new traffic to llm-llama4x-quant variant (lower perf but lighter memory). I'll open route swap.
alex: commands I'll run:
```
# set rpm
rbctl quota update --model llm-llama4x --region us-west1 --rpm 1200 --reason "auto-mitigate high tpm"
# disable funcall
rbctl feature toggle --model llm-llama4x --feature funcall --state off --duration 30m
# create routing
rbctl route create --from llm-llama4x --to llm-llama4x-quant --percent 30 --region us-west1
```
priya: doing canary now on control plane, will push to fleet in 60s and watch 1-min SLOs.
matt: FYI support impact: a couple of customers may see increased latency or tool failures. tagging @support-leads to prep messaging.
sara: I'll post a short status note in #incidents and tag affected customers list.
deploy-bot: Quota update queued -> job 98765. Estimated completion 42s.
alex: Job finished. RPM set to 1200. Observability: queue length dropping, latency p95 improving.
priya: Funcall toggle succeeded. Tooling errors expected to drop; confirmed errors down 70%.
ryan: Route swap in progress, 30% traffic now hitting quant variant. CPU on quant fleet stable.
matt: Good. Keeping this mitigation for 40m, then reassess. If stable, gradually lift RPM.
sara: Notifying support and posting update to customers now. :email:
alex: postmortem note — root cause looks like regression in KV cache indexing for certain prefixes, patch in progress by eng-runtime.
priya: will coordinate rollback/patch and safe rollouts. Adding to follow-up oncall ticket.
ryan: closing pager but keep this thread as handoff to eng-runtime. tagging @eng-runtime.
incident-bot: Incident 5512345678 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Oncall handoff to eng-runtime for root cause.
